interpretation.title: The result
paragraphs: The Jul 18 DEXA measured 7.7% body fat, with 5.6 lb of measured fat lost since the prior scan. Lean tissue finished at 147.5 lb, −1.6 lb from the May 24 baseline and within the established preservation tolerance. The photos reinforce that result: from the beginning of the cut through today, your waist is substantially leaner, abdominal definition is clearer, and your upper body has been preserved.

The final front relaxed photo was taken later in the day after training, so it is not a perfect laboratory comparison. It is still clear enough to assess when viewed alongside the full journey, the recent same-pose comparisons, and the supporting views.
The evidence supports completion, while your explicit confirmation remains the final step.

interpretation.title: The result
paragraphs: Objective result: The Jul 18 DEXA measured 7.7% body fat, with 5.6 lb of measured fat lost since the prior scan. Lean tissue finished at 147.5 lb, −1.6 lb from the May 24 baseline and within the established preservation tolerance.

Visual result: Front Relaxed is the primary validator, the full journey shows a substantially leaner waist and midsection, and the recent comparison shows continued refinement. Rear Relaxed, Rear Flexed, Right Side Relaxed, and Front Flexed strengthen the end-of-cut picture.
Confidence is moderate. The post-workout state and lighting differences reduce comparison precision, but the subject remains sharp, fully visible, and usable for evaluation.
Taken together, the objective and visual evidence support completion. Your explicit decision is still required.
